title: EEG dataset for speech decoding
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from phoneme discrimination tasks combined with transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) of the motor cortex. It merges two studies: a 2019 study of consonant-vowel and vowel-consonant pairs in 8 participants, and a 2021 study in 16 participants that added single phonemes, real words and pseudowords. It is intended to support research on speech decoding and the role of articulation and coarticulation in speech perception.
methods_description: Participants listened to speech sounds and identified stimuli with a button press while EEG was recorded. TMS was delivered with a Magstim Super Rapid Plus1 stimulator and a figure-of-eight 40 mm coil, using paired pulses with a 50 ms interpulse interval at 110% of resting motor threshold. Targets were lip and tongue areas of M1 in both studies, plus Broca's area (BA 44) and a verbal memory region (BA 6) in Study 2.
